verdict.rationale: Phaser is scripted directly in JavaScript or TypeScript. It ships full TypeScript definitions that VSCode picks up automatically, and its Editor includes a code editor with IntelliSense. Community reports describe it as easy to learn and straightforward for building games, so the productive-language and API-exposure parts of the story are well supported. However, nothing in the pack documents a Phaser-provided debugger, and browser devtools would be a host-platform feature rather than Phaser's own. Missing for 10: any documented first-party debugger, explicit evidence that the full engine API is exposed and typed beyond the mention of the types folder.
